newsitem.title: UK: Arjo Wiggins Q3 turnover rises 3.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Arjo Wiggins Q3 turnover rises 3.5 percent.

text.p: UK-based speciality paper group Arjo Wiggins Appleton Plc, which has to disclose regular statistics to the Paris bourse, said on Thursday third quarter turnover rose 3.5 percent to 840.9 million stg.
The group siad total sales in the first nine months of 1996 rose 2.2 percent to 2.70 billion stg.

However, excluding the effect of acquisitions, disposals and the development of coated free sheet paper in the U.S., third quarter and nine-month figures represented decreases of 3.2 percent and 7.4 percent respectively over the same periods of 1995.
